note: Official PS5 list: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, checked 20 Nov 2026). Guides in our own words; src keys: pyx = PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide, exo = Exophase trophy list, psn = PSNProfiles trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. No online play and no DLC are involved, so work the list in roadmap order and it lands on its own at the end.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Plays out on its own: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and the trophy pops. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic once Chapter 1 ends; the first mission of Chapter 2 closes it out. Just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic at the end of Chapter 2; the first mission of Chapter 3 closes it. Story only, nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops once Chapter 3 is done, early in Chapter 4. Keep following the main missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. The gold for the final mission lands with it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The finale: finish the last main mission and this gold pops alongside the Chapter 4 trophy. One playthrough is enough.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Story only.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Story only.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story only.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Story only.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long haul, and the hardest trophy on the list. After the story the 100% checklist opens under Progress, then Stats; progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and needs 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, plus every robbery, underwater find, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Nothing on it is missable, and most of it arrives while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixing stunt jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track them by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the 100% checklist later wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. Most arrive on their own through the story and the other trophies; check Progress, then Activities, for the ones still left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals at all 12 shooting ranges, 42 challenges in total. None of them is very hard, so work through them with a steady weapon and repeat the ones you miss; PowerPyx maps every range.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun spots, 42 races in all. Learn each course line first, then race for the win; the locations are marked once you unfog the map.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the game's race types. Any 20 distinct race locations count, and there are 40 to choose from, so pick the ones that suit your driving.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento. Go there, take the challenge, and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games end to end: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind play on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the map. Reaching the end is enough; the extra challenges are optional.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only strand in Belville: after Andy calls in Chapter 3, run her five quests — the Cellerichain chain, the fee, the initiation, the van job, and the warehouse meet. It stays open after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving strand from Key Lento: clear his 7 shipwrecks, using the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each haul back. He goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 and 3, so nothing is missable; track it under Progress, then Collections.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break: five jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes. Still open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain open-world strangers count — Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's races and Pilot Pete's deliveries are confirmed so far. The big named questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not count. Watch the trophy tracker for your total; more strangers are still being found.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wishlist: after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS hands you the Key Cloner, deliver the 16 sports cars he wants, starting with the Zorrusso from that mission. Track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List; cars he marks appear in fixed spots, and good-condition deliveries pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only: after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, smash the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City, then take Tyrone's second quest to shut them down for good. All of it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy that can slip away. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, and meditating as both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept, or the moment is gone for good. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that home meditation is required, but doing it costs nothing and protects the run. The last spot only opens once both characters can play together, after Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only hunting strand: after Coffee Break, Bret texts you about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His quests send you after animals he requests; bring them in as Jason. Bret hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle on the first quest — one clean shot keeps the pelt pristine and pays better. PowerPyx notes the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being pinned down, but finishing his 15 Target Decks covers it and feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations; grab sets as you pass them and the third completed set pops the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app (hold up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags add up to far more than 100, so scan whatever you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist later wants 70, so this pops on the way. Track them under Progress, then Challenges, and pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters together, so it opens after Coffee Break. Call your partner, stir up a 4-star wanted level, then break out of the red heat zone — a fast bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia shakes the helicopter. It also pops naturally while robbing the big bank vaults in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without losing the wanted level — the flashing red-blue level, not the full heat. Gear up with armor, sticky bombs and healing first. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's jobs open them; the trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and a fourth shop covers a slow start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing; you never need to drive them. The checklist later wants 200 of 277, so this comes free.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming) and drop 5 enemies in the one slow-time burst. Eat or drink to top up focus, pop Adrenaline to stretch it, wear armor, and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 on a group at a gang operation. It does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians, and Focus level 4 makes it far easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a VCIA departure bridge — the E3/E4 plane is the easy one — climb to the cockpit, reverse it to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport. Planes parked out on the field do not count.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the island in south-west Mariana County; the tanks sit in the south of the base. Drive in, climb aboard and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun. Then slip into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, smash the security footage and kill the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target; it pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault stands open and hand a bag to your partner. After that, Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 a tip. Five vaults pop the trophy; the checklist wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Pops from the same Chapter 4 mission as the vaults — tailing the truck to the bank counts as the robbery. Earlier still, you can stop a roaming armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its rear door and escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map — 52 areas. A plane is the fast way: sweep over every blacked-out patch until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; yellow icons mark them as you get close. The checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Newly confirmed: head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, order an Apple Martini and drink it beside the bar with the view. Confirmed by PowerPyx's trophy guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Newly confirmed: after the Key Cloner arrives in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, take the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III — and the pop comes a moment after you reach the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — and take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (sticky bombs open it). Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first. It pops after you escape the police, and the valuables can be collected across repeat visits, so nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength. It opens after Coffee Break lets you switch freely. Buy a gym membership, always bring your partner along (they train while you do), and work the Vice City fitness clubs. Home workouts open after the story too.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that move your criminal profile — the trophy list itself tracks the count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD) so a demon face flags each one. Stealthy jobs, clean escapes and quiet takedowns count as Professional; violence pushes you toward Violent, Psycho and, permanently, Irredeemable. It builds passively through every robbery and fight, and only needs farming at the very end.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it ties to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a particular way — in Little Cuba, Vice City. No verified steps exist yet, so this guide will not invent any; check back as the community pins it down. Flagged unconfirmed in this guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Newly confirmed: the UFO easter egg. After 2 AM, head alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, and when it drops the woman it took, talk to her and help her back to her car. The spawn is slightly random — drive away and return if the car is not there.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Newly confirmed: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — a melee drive-by. Crowded streets in Vice City or along Ocean Beach fill the count fast.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to get the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best. The $250,000 counts across all deliveries, and one bank vault can hand you up to $205,000 in a few minutes.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they move the total fastest. Ammu-Nations, mod shops, clothing and tattoo studios all count.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which arrives after Chapter 2's Daily Driver. Together they cost $160,000; late-game robberies fund them fastest.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands after Chapter 2's Moses mission. Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots — then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low.
